results.title: Raiven 2.0: A Revolutionary Step in Building Trades Procurement Automation - Third News
highlights:
In a strategic move aimed at revolutionizing procurement for the building industry, Raiven has announced the launch of Raiven 2.0. This significant update integrates advanced sourcing technology specifically designed to streamline the often cumbersome procurement processes faced by contractors. With its patented Best Value™ sourcing technology, Raiven 2.0 promises to enhance efficiency and ensure that contractors make informed purchasing decisions.
...
With the launch of Raiven 2.0, the company also lays the groundwork for what it calls the Agentic Chief Procurement Office—an ambitious vision intended to empower all contractors with sophisticated procurement tools typically reserved for larger firms. By developing an agentic framework that integrates sourcing, supplier management, and spend intelligence, Raiven opens the door for enhanced decision-making across various business sizes. Tracy K. Price, Chairman of the Board, remarked, "Every work order essentially comprises both labor and materials. Failing to master both will hinder overall control. Raiven 2.0 embodies the realization of our patent ambition from four years ago, now brought to life."
...
Raiven acts as an Agentic Chief Procurement Office tailored for the building trades, focusing on contractors in fields such as electrical, HVAC, and multi-trade services. The platform merges trade-specific AI tools, a mobile application, analytical insights, and a curated network of suppliers—all designed to complement existing contractor relationships. At its core, Raiven’s Best Value™ system enables contractors to make well-informed value-based procurement decisions. By assessing various factors beyond just price, Raiven guarantees that contractors receive the maximum value for their projects. In conclusion, Raiven 2.0 marks a significant leap forward in the procurement process for building trades, offering contractors a streamlined, efficient solution tailored to meet their specific needs.
